Report daily sales for these three sale periods:

1. Black Friday 2024: WooCommerce online, from 8 November 2024 at 08:00 GMT until 11 November 2024 at 00:00 GMT, end exclusive. Exclude POS.
2. Black Friday 2025: native Shopify Online Store, 27–30 November inclusive. Label 27 November VIP early access and 28–30 November public sale. Exclude POS and migrated WooCommerce orders.
3. May Bank Holiday 2026: native Shopify, 1–4 May inclusive. Split Online Store and POS, combining POS locations. Keep unknown channels separate.

Use Europe/London calendar days. Show one row per date, channel and currency, with gross sales including tax, refunds and sales after refunds where supported. Include a subtotal for each period, channel and currency. Keep currencies separate.

Use the same sales definitions as the completed reports. Retrieve actual daily evidence; do not allocate period totals across days. Reconcile daily sums against the earlier period totals where retained evidence is available, and explain any differences. Missing data must remain unavailable, not zero.

Retain successful sections if another fails. Do not collect new source data or modify anything.
